replace.foxwillow/gate.dialogue:start:lucan_houn: Good heavens. A wall of corn with a doorman. I'd grade the workmanship highly.

replace.memorys_rest/rooms2c.dialogue:l25_saved:: Easy now. We'll get your proper name back in the ledger.
